 Print Latest weather update and forecast for Washington DC. Washington DC is experiencing pleasant weather today, October 27, 2026. With a maximum temperature reaching 22°C and a minimum of 8°C, residents can expect a comfortable day with partly sunny conditions. The humidity is relatively high at 91%, but the lack of precipitation makes it an ideal day for outdoor activities. Light winds at 16.09 kph will add to the overall comfort of the day. Washington DC Weather Today
 Today's weather in Washington DC is characterized by partly sunny skies, promising a pleasant afternoon for outdoor activities. The temperatures will range from a low of 8°C in the early hours to a warm high of 22°C, making it a great day for exploring the city or enjoying time in the parks. The average temperature of 15°C ensures that conditions remain comfortable throughout the day. Humidity levels at 91% will create a hint of mugginess, although no rainfall is anticipated. With a zero percent chance of rain, residents can confidently plan their activities without the risk of inclement weather. Wind speeds will remain calm at 16.09 kph, providing a gentle breeze that enhances the day's overall enjoyment. As we progress through the day, temperatures will steadily rise, with the peak warmth expected in the afternoon. This afternoon warmth creates an ideal backdrop for late autumn outings or casual gatherings with friends. Good conditions for evening activities
 With today’s favorable weather, residents are encouraged to take advantage of the pleasant conditions. It’s an excellent day for outdoor dining or leisurely strolls in the park. As the sun sets at 6:14 PM, the evening remains mild, making it comfortable for after-work activities or family outings. Don't forget to wear layers, as temperatures might drop slightly into the evening, but overall, it promises to be a pleasant night in the city. Washington DC Weather for Upcoming 7 Days

 Next week appears to follow a similar theme, with warm temperatures and plenty of sunshine. The warmest day in the upcoming forecast will be October 30, with a peak temperature of 26°C, making it an excellent day for outdoor activities. However, cooler temperatures will start to set in by early November, with highs dropping to around 19°C. While the weather remains predominantly pleasant, there is a possibility of scattered showers on November 3. Residents should prepare for some fluctuations in weather as we progress into November, but for now, the outlook is bright and inviting.
